verdict.rationale: PagerDuty provides documented webhook subscriptions (V3 webhooks) that deliver HTTP callbacks for significant account events, configurable via webhook subscriptions with event types, plus REST API access to manage these programmatically — directly enabling an AI-native consumer to subscribe to events via webhooks. This is well documented in first-party developer docs. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of webhook reliability or AI-agent-specific webhook consumption patterns.
